name: Homepage

database.label: No database; everything lives in plain YAML files in the config folder

resourceFootprint.notes: Very light. In our test LXC (1 core, 512 MB) the container used about 140 MB of RAM and idled at 0% CPU while showing 14 services with status checks, system resources and a search box. The image is about 255 MB. Config changes to services.yaml and widgets.yaml apply without a restart.

screenshots.label: Dashboard
screenshots.altEn: Homepage dashboard in dark theme with services grouped into Infrastructure, AI & Creative and Home & Productivity, CPU, memory and disk widgets and a search box

screenshots.label: Light theme
screenshots.altEn: The same Homepage dashboard in light theme with a soft blue and lilac gradient background

screenshots.label: Mobile
screenshots.altEn: Homepage dashboard on a phone-sized screen with the service groups stacked in a single column

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      # Hostnames you open the dashboard from, otherwise you get a host validation error.
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: "localhost:3000,192.168.1.40:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
      - ./images:/app/public/images
descriptionEn: Homepage is a fast, highly customisable start page for your homelab. You describe your services, widgets and bookmarks in a few YAML files and it renders a clean dashboard with icons, live status checks, system resource widgets, a search box and light and dark themes. More than a hundred service integrations (Proxmox, Jellyfin, Pi-hole, Docker and many more) can show live stats, and the config reloads without a restart. It stores no data in a database, so backing it up is just copying the config folder.
taglineEn: A clean, YAML-configured start page for all your homelab services.
seoTitleEn: Homepage: self-hosted homelab dashboard with Docker Compose — HomelabDeck
seoDescriptionEn: Homepage (gethomepage) is a lightweight YAML-configured homelab dashboard with status checks, widgets and dark/light themes. Ready docker-compose.yml, ~140 MB RAM and screenshots from our own test.
useCasesEn: A single start page with links to every service in your homelab.
Seeing live status and stats from services such as Proxmox, Jellyfin, Pi-hole and Docker on one screen.
Using it as the browser home page on all your devices, with a search box and bookmarks.
Keeping the dashboard in version control, because the whole configuration is a few YAML files.
caveatsEn: There is no editor in the UI. Every change is made in the YAML files, so you need to be comfortable editing them.
Widgets that show live stats need API keys for each service, so keep the config folder private.
Since version 1.0 you must list the hostnames it is served on in HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS, or the page will not load.
It has no login of its own. Keep it on your local network or put authentication in front of it.
